description: May 9 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 2, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 9 birthday falls in Taurus, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: The May 9 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Nine closes the single-digit cycle, and on May 9th it brings a wider, more humanitarian outlook to a sign that often keeps its circle small. With the Sun eighteen degrees into Taurus and Mercury shading the decan, people born today are often pictured as practical idealists, the ones who quietly fund the community garden, repair the shared bench, and rarely mention it.

Astronomically, May 9 puts the Sun near 18° Taurus in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Mercury, the ruler of Virgo, acts as sub-ruler for Taurus between 10 and 19 degrees, roughly the first ten days of May. That pairing brings a practical intelligence to the sign's patience. These Taureans are frequently pictured as craftspeople at heart: they like to learn how something works, refine it and make it last. Speech tends to be measured and grounded in specifics. The Virgoan undertone can add a critical eye, which is helpful in a workshop or a spreadsheet and sometimes less welcome at the dinner table. Their gift is turning ideas into durable, useful things that other people can rely on for years.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for May 9
paragraphs: Born on the 9th, your birthday number is 9, the last and broadest of the single digits. Numerologists see the birth day as a secondary number that describes a natural gift. The 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and a wide view of humanity, perhaps because it contains something of every number before it. Those with this birthday often find themselves helping, teaching or creating for audiences beyond their own circle. Letting go can be a recurring theme for 9s, along with learning that finishing one chapter makes space for a better one.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a May 9 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous May 9 birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 9 is the 129th day of the year (130th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Gemini, is usually complete within 12 days, by May 21.

By May 9 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a May 9 birthday are J. M. Barrie (1860), Howard Carter (1874) and Glenda Jackson (1936).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 9?
faq.answer: May 9 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 9?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 9 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 9th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 9?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 9, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 9?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on May 9 include J. M. Barrie (1860), Howard Carter (1874) and Glenda Jackson (1936). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
